part: Part 20: Pitt interviewer-free cut (Part 16 POD4 arm B, PAR-only), built once on the Mac for all pods
command: cd <local data dir>/release/scores/part20/pitt_noinv_cut && /usr/local/bin/python3 src/build_pitt_noinv.py ; COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 tar --no-mac-metadata -czf pitt_noinv_clips.tgz clips manifest.csv
logic: per window: heard span = first min(end_ms-start_ms, 30000) ms of the segment wav; merged timed *PAR intervals from the CHAT file clipped to that span, as offsets into the segment wav; concatenated with a 5 ms raised-cosine fade in and out on each piece (pieces under 10 ms kept unfaded, as in cut_arms.py); 16 kHz mono PCM_16. Parser parse_cha/merge/clip_to/total loaded verbatim from part16/POD4/cha_overlap.py.

sources.segment_wavs: <local data dir>/DementiaBank/segments/<orig_clip_id> (the 30 s window wavs; source_segments.sha256 lists all 468)

reproduction_check.per_clip_vs_POD4_cut_report: 468/468 identical duration (max abs diff 0.000 s), identical n_par and inv_ms

manifest_columns.n_inv_utts_removed: merged timed *INV intervals overlapping the heard 30 s span (cha_overlap n_inv_utt)

notes: dur_par_s equals the CHAT PAR ms inside the span for every clip (no clip hit the segment end).
Untimed *INV speech is not visible to this cut; only timed CHAT intervals are removed, same as POD4.
